gloss: A pocket of saliva that gathers under the skin flap after the operation. Drawn as an outline: an illustration of the idea, not a measured shape.
role: A collection of saliva under the skin flap (a sialocele) or a leak of saliva through the wound is one of the commoner early problems; in one large series it affected roughly one patient in eleven, mostly within a month, and all settled.
matters: In one series a sialocele or fistula was more likely after an inferior or middle superficial parotidectomy than after other extents of dissection.
